questions.answer: it is something completely different, the professors are really unorganized and seem like they don't want to teach, a lot of the stuff they are saying is not in line with the curriculum, and the discussion in class are the students own opinion rather than theory based

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your second semester. *
What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Media in foreign policy - Daniel Drake was amazing 
Resolving the Israel-Palestine Conflict - This course was very nice theoretically, but the other students ruined it for me since they didn't argue from a theoretical perspective but from their own views on the conflict, most of them was really racist and that was very sad

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. Do not focus too much on school, you are gonna pass and yes the teaching is bad!!
2. Enjoy that it is so cheap compared to CPH, go out to eat a lot!!
3. If you enjoy techno, go to ankali, it is such a cool place
